description: Native d16 Enyo-owned RC lane. No new training runs from this config; validate and package the existing d16 huber/sign net as the current Berserk-replacement candidate.

validation.last_result: The Enyo-owned d16 huber/sign net reached -5.4 +/- 12.0 Elo versus Berserk after 2000 games. Scalar pairwise repair of its search misses is rejected: it improved some root cases but did not stabilize the descendant search gate.
validation.next_gate: Validate native-d16-owned-rc1 with fixed replay/loss gates and candidate-excess search gates before any copy/promotion. If clean, run a bounded Berserk confirm as RC validation.
